home.label: What the home page shows
home.help: The portal is Masthead's front page. Choose the discussion list to keep Flarum's own index as the home page; the portal stays at /portal. This is the same setting as Home page in Basics.

preset.label: Preset
preset.help: A preset sets the accent, the masthead colour, the featured-story layout and the corners at once. Anything you change below is kept when you switch presets.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.help: The rule under the masthead, the kickers and the main buttons. Flarum's primary colour follows Appearance, including its dark-mode variant.

bar.label: Masthead colour
bar.help: The header's background. Unless you set the strip below, the utility strip above it is drawn a shade darker.

strip.label: Utility strip colour
strip.help: The thin bar above the header, with the date and the sign-in links. Leave empty to draw it a shade darker than the masthead.

ground.label: Page background (light mode)
ground.help: The colour the white cards sit on.

ground_dark.label: Page background (dark mode)
ground_dark.help: The colour the cards sit on in dark mode. Leave empty to follow Flarum's own dark background, a shade darker.

brand.tagline_help: A short line under the forum's name, such as "College football community". Leave empty for none.
brand.monogram_help: Up to three characters in the tile beside the name, shown when no logo is uploaded (Appearance → Logo). Leave empty to use the forum name's initials.
brand.show_name_label: Show the forum name beside the logo
brand.show_name_help: Turn off when your logo already contains the name.
brand.fonts_help: Barlow Condensed for headings and Figtree for text, served from your own forum. Turn off to use the reader's system fonts instead.

hero.style_help: How the featured story sits. Full width puts the headline over the picture; split puts them side by side.
hero.source_help: Where the featured story and the three beside it come from. When a source has fewer than four, the newest discussions fill the rest.
hero.type_help: The slug of the content type whose records are featured, such as articles.

topic.lead_image_label: Show a lead image on discussions
topic.lead_image_help: The first picture in a discussion's opening post, shown as a wide banner at the top of the article. Discussions without a picture show none.

portal.tag_count_help: How many top-level tags the Browse the forum grid shows before All sections.

footer.label: Footer links
footer.help: Links shown in the footer of every page. An address can be a path on this forum (/p/1-rules), a web address or a mailto link. Drag to reorder.
footer.name: Name
